input.rationale: Section 17 addresses only the return of Garman's materials by Sparkling; neither Section 17, the survival clause (Section 18), the escrow provisions (Section 16) nor the confidentiality section (Section 14) requires Garman to provide any exit assistance or to return or delete Sparkling's data on expiry or termination. No usable transition clause exists anywhere, so we insert one at the preferred position (six months' assistance at then-current rates, data return in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, certified deletion after return), using "Sparkling's data" because the agreement has no defined "Customer Data" term.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return obligations in Section 17
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit clause: on expiry or termination Garman provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns Sparkling's data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days and certifies deletion thereafter. The agreement currently requires only that Sparkling return Garman's materials.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) at Sparkling's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in Garman's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (3) after such return, delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to Sparkling.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
